note: Assertions grade the `judgment` half of each plant. The `scanner` half is already covered deterministically in tests/test_fixture_detection.py, so nothing here re-checks whether evidence was surfaced -- only what was made of it.

evals.name: vocabulary-breakpoint
evals.prompt: 我接手了一個 ad serving 的服務，原本寫的人已經離職了，沒有留下任何文件。code 在 <FIXTURE>。我想先搞清楚這個系統在業務上到底在處理什麼、有哪些核心概念，不要跟我講 Go 的分層架構或 package 怎麼切。
evals.expected_output: Passes A and B only. A candidate vocabulary list with domain/technical classifications, the click_id vs conversion_id conflict recorded unresolved, and a stop for review -- not a finished ontology.

assertions.text: Stops for review after the vocabulary pass instead of producing a finished ontology with workflows and axioms
Records the click_id / conversion_id disagreement without picking a winner
Classifies AdRequest as a domain concept despite it being infrastructure-shaped vocabulary
Classifies RedisKeyBuilder and HTTPMiddleware as technical artifacts, not domain concepts
Presents questions to the reviewer in one batch with proposed defaults rather than asking one at a time
Describes concepts in business language a non-programmer could follow, with no Go types or package paths in the descriptions

evals.name: full-ontology-unattended
evals.prompt: 幫我把 <FIXTURE> 這個服務的商業邏輯萃取成一份 domain ontology 的 YAML 檔。我這兩天在外面開會沒辦法即時回你問題，所以不要停下來等我 —— 不確定的地方就記成 open question 附上你建議的答案，我回來再一起看。
evals.expected_output: A complete <name>.ontology.yml following references/ontology-schema.yml, with every low-confidence claim carrying a matching open_questions entry.

assertions.text: Produces a YAML file with the schema's sections: system, vocabulary, concepts, workflows, axioms, relations, open_questions
The 7-day cool-off appears as an axiom at confidence 0.7 or higher, because a written contract rationale sits beside the constant
The undocumented 50000 daily spend cap is recorded at confidence 0.3 or lower AND carries a matching open_questions entry
The 30-second upstream timeout does not appear in axioms
The 2700ms decision timeout is not an axiom but does raise an open question about why the value is so specific
Returning the first creative when none qualify is treated as a policy decision, not dismissed as defensive coding
The disagreement between the comment saying 3 impressions and the constant saying 5 is raised as an open question, without silently trusting either side
The settlement status lifecycle appears as workflow or concept lifecycle in business language, not as a list of Go constants
Neither RedisKeyBuilder nor HTTPMiddleware appears in concepts
No concept property carries a storage type such as bigint, varchar, numeric or TEXT
No rank_score, layer count or other scanner output appears anywhere in the ontology
Every relation subject and object either resolves to a declared id or is described as an external concept

evals.name: business-rules-only
evals.prompt: <FIXTURE> 這包 code 裡面到底藏了哪些商業規則？我下週要跟廣告主做合約 review，需要知道系統實際上在執行哪些限制，還有哪些是我們自己加的、合約裡其實沒寫。
evals.expected_output: The axioms/business constraints separated from technical constants, each with its evidence and confidence, and an explicit list of what could not be confirmed from the code.

assertions.text: The 7-day cool-off is identified as contractual, citing the comment that says so
Connection timeouts and pool sizes are excluded from axioms
Separates axioms backed by written evidence from axioms that are inferred, rather than presenting all of them at one confidence
States plainly which constraints could not be confirmed from the code, instead of filling the gaps with plausible-sounding rules
The frequency cap contradiction (comment 3, code 5) is surfaced as something to verify before the contract review
